retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome group portrait featuring a central figure surrounded by others, topped with a clean horizontal header bar for display text.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white group photo
excludeWhen: modern digital clean-cut styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a group of people, anchored by a central laughing figure, with a thin white horizontal bar at the top containing spaced-out slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure acts as the focal point for the surrounding group
High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights creates a gritty texture
The white header bar provides a clean geometric counterpoint to the organic photographic forms
Tight cropping creates an intimate, crowded energy
coreInvariants: Monochrome color palette with high grain
Horizontal header bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central female figure in the lower-middle foreground, surrounded by five other figures at varying depths and heights.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's laughing expression and the bright white header bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright header, moves down to the central face, then circles outward to the surrounding group members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, with small pockets of dark shadow between them.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal black for shadows and clothing
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the header bar and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin textures and denim
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric slab serif with consistent stroke weight

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a dedicated white header bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with wide tracking for a clean, modern-retro look.
graphicDevices: Small logo box in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric slab serif structure and light weight.
Provides the clean, modern slab serif feel with open counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a group of 6 people in 1970s attire, laughing and looking at the camera. Leave a solid white horizontal bar at the very top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab-serif text in a dark gray color inside the white top bar, using wide tracking and centered alignment.

verificationChecks: Is there a distinct white bar at the top?
Is the text centered and widely spaced?
Is the photographic style grainy and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Width of the top header bar
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white bar is perfectly horizontal
Ensure no color bleed in the monochrome image
Verify the slab serifs are sharp and consistent
Confirm the central figure is the brightest part of the photo
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome group photo + white header bar + wide-tracked slab serif = Retro Soul Aesthetic
